messages:
sophia: Heads up — merged the fused-RoPE scaling change (sha ab12f3c) into canary and seeing p99 regression on paged FlashAttention for long-context chat workloads. numbers below. :grimacing:

miguel: ugh. numbers?

sophia: bench run on canary node (A100-80GB), batch=8, seq=8192, rotary_dim=64, paged=on, kernel_selector=auto
```
./bench/paged_flash_bench --model gpt-like --batch 8 --seq 8192 --rotary-dim 64
p50: 22.3ms -> 24.1ms (+8%)
p95: 41.2ms -> 59.8ms (+45%)
p99: 68.9ms -> 142.4ms (+107%)
throughput tok/s: 3.2k -> 1.9k (-40%)
GPU mem spike: 44GB -> 62GB
```

alex: that p99 jump is huge. does it correlate with KV cache growth/eviction?

sophia: yes — traces show thrashing when paged attention requests pages as we append prefixes. KV cache eviction increases host<->device copies. see stack trace snippet.

hema: can you paste the kernel selection log? maybe selector picked FlashPaged+fused-rope variant that forces dense KV layout.

sophia: log:
```
[selector] candidate=flash_paged_fused_rope rot_dim=64 seq=8192 est_latency=120ms
[selector] candidate=flash_paged_unfused rot_dim=64 seq=8192 est_latency=60ms
selected=flash_paged_fused_rope
```

miguel: why did selector prefer fused variant if est_latency is higher? bug in cost model or stale profiling data.

triage-bot: incident created ML-PERF-2026-042; paging the oncall.

alex: quick mitigations: 1) pin kernel_selector to unfused for rotary_dim <= 64 in canary 2) lower paged prefetch window 3) revert fused-rope commit if urgent.

sophia: tried 1) pin -> p99 back to 72ms, throughput 2.8k. 2) reduced prefetch -> stable but CPU load up. 3) reverting now on canary to validate.

devops-bot: deploy started: rollback-to ab12e99 (pre-fused-rope) on canary.

hema: for long term: update kernel selector cost model to include KV-page fault rate and rotate_dim scaling. Also add microbench for fused vs unfused across rotary dims {32,64,128} and seq lengths.

miguel: +1 add CI perf gate for p99 regression > 20% on smoke long-context bench.

sophia: plan: revert in canary today, add selector fix + new microbench, add metric alert (ML-P99) — I'll post PRs. assigning owners: selector=hema, bench=miguel, revert=sophia.

alex: thanks. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
